high_level_description: stc brand style, three cyclists riding mountain bikes on a dirt path through a desert landscape.

compositional_deconstruction.background: A vast desert landscape with sandy-colored terrain, distant rocky formations, and a bright blue sky with wispy white clouds.

elements.desc: A cyclist in the center wearing a red and beige windbreaker jacket, black cycling pants, and a gray helmet.
A cyclist on the left wearing a light gray jacket and black helmet.
A cyclist on the right wearing a purple jacket and black helmet.
Three modern mountain bikes ridden by the cyclists, all wearing protective gloves.
